# Pydantic AI Capabilities and Tools: What's Available, to Revisit

Saved 2026-11-17 to look back on and decide whether to use any of these. Read from the versions installed
in this repo then (`pydantic-ai 2.68`, `pydantic-ai-harness 0.68`): re-check before building, the library
moves fast. Capabilities are plug-ins added with `Agent(capabilities=[...])`; each can bring tools,
instructions, settings or hooks. Docs on using them: `.agents/skills/building-pydantic-ai-agents/` and
`.agents/skills/pydantic-ai-harness/`.

## What this repo uses today

`pkgs/ds/ai/agent.py`: only its own capabilities (knowledge, SmashDb, mechanics, Little Mac, start.gg,
SmashTube, `ToolCallLog`), loaded on demand, with prompt caching on. `Coder` (harness) is imported but
commented out.

## Worth a look first

| Candidate | Why it could fit | From |
|---|---|---|
| `ToolSearch` | as capabilities keep growing, the model searches the tool list instead of seeing all of it | built in |
| `spend` / `CostTracking` | a spend cap inside the app; the Gateway's $5/month limit only blocks once hit (see the Spend tab) | harness / shields |
| `compaction` | long chats stop growing toward the context meter | harness |
| `WebFetch` / `WebSearch` | look things up (eg a SmashWiki page) mid-chat, provider-native when the model has it | built in |
| `code_mode` | the model writes Python that calls several tools in one go, fewer round trips | harness |

## 1. Built into Pydantic AI (`pydantic_ai.capabilities`)

| Group | Capabilities | What they do |
|---|---|---|
| Web and media | `WebSearch`, `WebFetch`, `XSearch`, `ImageGeneration`, `FileUnderstanding`, `Citations` | the provider's own tool when the model has one, else a local fallback (`NativeOrLocalTool`) |
| Model behaviour | `Thinking`, `Caching` (prompt caching), `ModelFallback`, `SelectModel` / `ModelSelection` | one setting across providers; switch models on failure or per request |
| Tools | `MCP` (an MCP server), `Toolset`, `ToolSearch`, `PrefixTools`, `PrepareTools`, `SetToolMetadata`, `IncludeToolReturnSchemas` | shape which tools the model sees, and how |
| History and context | `ProcessHistory` / `HistoryProcessor`, `ReinjectSystemPrompt` | trim or rewrite the conversation before each request |
| Control and observability | `Hooks` (wrap a run, request, tool call, output validation), `Instrumentation` (Logfire / OpenTelemetry), `HandleDeferredToolCalls` (human approval), `RaiseContentFilterError` | step into the agent's loop |
| Workspace | `LocalWorkspace` | files and shell on this machine |
| Composition | `CombinedCapability`, `DynamicCapability`, `WrapperCapability`, deferred loading (`defer_loading=True`) | build your own; load one only when the model asks for it |

**Provider-native tools** (`pydantic_ai.native_tools`, run by the model's provider): `WebSearchTool`,
`WebFetchTool`, `CodeExecutionTool`, `FileSearchTool`, `ImageGenerationTool`, `MemoryTool`,
`MCPServerTool`, `AdvisorTool`, `XSearchTool`.

**Common tools** (`pydantic_ai.common_tools`, run locally): DuckDuckGo, Tavily and Exa search, web fetch,
image generation, X search.

## 2. Pydantic's own extension: `pydantic-ai-harness`

About 100 capabilities, aimed at long-running and coding agents:

| Area | Examples |
|---|---|
| Coding and sandboxes | `Coder`, filesystem, shell, `code_mode`; Docker, E2B, Modal, Daytona, bubblewrap and other sandboxes |
| Delegation | `subagents`, `planning`, `dynamic_workflow`, `advisor` (a stronger model advises a cheaper one), `background_tools` |
| Context | `compaction`, `tool_output_limits`, `overflowing_tool_output`, `warn_on_cache_busts`, `cache_stability` |
| Memory and knowledge | `memory`, `conversation_search`, `skills` (loads `SKILL.md` files), `pydantic_ai_docs`, `repo_context` |
| Safety and control | `guardrails`, `prompt_injection_defender`, `permissions`, `tool_call_judge`, `trajectory_judge`, `ask_user`, `spend`, `detect_loops`, `repair_tool_arguments` |
| Research and browsing | `researcher`, Exa, You.com, `playwright`, `browser_use` |
| Hosted integrations | GitHub, Linear, Notion, Slack, Google Workspace, PostHog, Logfire (and its MCP server) |
| Runtime | `step_persistence` (save, resume or fork a run); AWS Lambda, Durable Task and Render runners |

## 3. Third-party packages already installed here

| Package | Provides |
|---|---|
| `pydantic-ai-shields` | `CostTracking`, `ToolGuard`, `InputGuard` / `OutputGuard`, `PromptInjection`, `PiiDetector`, `SecretRedaction`, `BlockedKeywords` |
| `pydantic-ai-todo` | `TodoCapability`: a todo list the agent keeps while it works |
| `subagents-pydantic-ai` | `SubAgentCapability`: sub-agents in the foreground or background, with a message bus |
| `pydantic-ai-backend` | workspaces in self-hosted sandboxes, plus file, grep and run tools |
| `summarization-pydantic-ai` | history summarization; in the package list but didn't import on 2026-11-17 (broken or unused?) |

Also installed: `fastmcp` and `mcp` (write your own MCP servers), `genai-prices` (the Agents tab's prices),
`logfire`.
